name: Arrival
idea: A parcel in liquid glass arrives through two fading glass after-images that slide back into depth, an app icon built the way iOS 26 icons are built.
why: It looks native on an iPhone home screen and shows the brand promise in one picture, your parcel coming towards you, so the courier app is the identity rather than a container for it.
risks: The glass effect needs screens; on vans, tape and the 1-bit label it falls back to a flat three-tile mark, and stacked rounded squares sit close to generic "layers" icons.
